source: an avatar buying game with a cute pink map and avatar decals to buy off of

image_prompt.text: A central oversized gathering square in the middle of the pink map, sized for a crowd of avatars browsing
Detailed cute spots built as backdrops for showing off a newly bought look
A distinct pink structure visible across the map so players can orient themselves
Stalls or stands around the map that avatar decals are bought from, with the decals displayed large enough to see

notes: Dress Up was the other candidate preset, but there is no runway, judging, or round structure in the prompt, so the static settlement was taken instead - personalization here is the avatar, never property.
No option covers a shop stall or an item display, so the decal vendors are carried as free text in image_prompt.

open_questions.ask: Is this one shop plaza you stand in, or a whole town of stores to walk between?
Is there anything to do besides browsing and buying - a runway, a hangout area, minigames to earn currency?

coverage_missing.ask: One plaza, or a whole shopping town?
Besides buying, is there anything to do here?
What is the currency, and is it earned in-game or bought?

answers.ask: Is this one shop plaza you stand in, or a whole town of stores to walk between?
answers.answer: Make it one small cute pink shop plaza, so players can easily browse the avatar decals.

answers.ask: Is there anything to do besides browsing and buying - a runway, a hangout area, minigames to earn currency?
answers.answer: The game is just for browsing and buying avatar decals; no runway, hangout area, or minigames are needed.
